description: apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/agent_runner.py still contains a silent 'except Exception: pass' handler when discovering local LLM provider config from models.json, swallowing unexpected bugs.
goal: Eliminate the silent 'except Exception: pass' block in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/agent_runner.py by narrowing it to expected typed exceptions (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError) and logging malformed or unreadable models.json details via logger.debug/warning with redacted messages while preserving agent_runner.py well within its 782-line budget and keeping existing public signatures and holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json untouched. Add focused hermetic unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_agent_runner.py verifying typed config errors are handled cleanly while unexpected errors propagate, and verify uv run pytest and uv run task lint pass. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Removing the silent except Exception: pass in agent_runner.py ensures local provider lookup failures are observable without hiding programming bugs.
acceptance_criteria: Zero silent `except Exception: pass` blocks remain in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/agent_runner.py.

Unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_agent_runner.py verify malformed or unreadable local models.json failures are narrowed and logged while unexpected exceptions propagate (`uv run pytest -n auto --dist worksteal -m "not integration_test and not stress"`, `uv run task lint`, and `uv run task lint-docs` pass; holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json untouched), and code is self-explaining (no docstrings; only '# why:' comments).
